annotations.title: Find students with an upcoming birthday

description: Active students whose birthday falls today or in the next days (default 7, up to 60), nearest first, with name, birthday (the next date), turns (the age they reach), days_until, phone (the guardian's for a dependent) and app_url of the profile. Use it to answer "who has a birthday this week?" so the trainer can congratulate them, then get_student for one of them. Students without a birth date in the profile are not listed. Read only: nothing changes and no message is sent.

days.description: Look-ahead window in days, 0 to 60. Default 7.

name: list_birthdays
title: Find students with an upcoming birthday
